scoring_justification: T1 recompute is infeasible because the verifier sandbox cannot re-run the full self-consistent Kohn-Sham solver. Therefore agent-reported energies are compared to paper-reported gold values with tolerances; additional structural checks verify ordering and LSD hydrogen close to exact value (these checks are now disclosed in the instruction).

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold total energies for H (LSD -13.38 eV, LD -12.25 eV) and Na (LSD -323.268 Ry, LD -323.247 Ry) and cohesive energy 1.17 eV.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table II and text sections III.A and IV.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's reported numbers.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact published values the paper reports.

outputs.description: Total energies of the hydrogen atom in LSD and LD approximations.
Total energies of the sodium atom in LSD and LD approximations, in Rydbergs.
Improved LSD cohesive energy of sodium, combining atom energies with Tong's reference value and a correlation correction.

output_contract.notes: All outputs are fixed physical quantities; the checker compares the agent's reported values to hidden paper gold numbers within tolerances. Units are as declared. The agent must compute the Kohn-Sham atom energies from scratch using the provided exchange-correlation interpolation formulas.
